title: A Framework for Critical Evaluation of Text-to-Image Models: Integrating Art Historical Analysis, Artistic Exploration, and Critical Prompt Engineering.

bias_targets.methodology: Applying art historical and iconographical analysis to evaluate how models modernize classic Western artworks, identifying the inappropriate introduction of orientalist elements or over-reliance on Western religious iconography to represent non-Western cultures.

Using critical prompt engineering to manipulate gender pronouns in prompts describing authoritative roles (e.g., construction site managers), and evaluating the resulting visual representations of competence, posture, and authority through the lens of feminist theory.
Using artistic exploration with nuanced prompts about domestic labor to observe the disproportionate generation of people of color, analyzed through the lens of critical race theory.
Crafting prompts inspired by artistic aesthetic practices that highlight the resilience and dignity of domestic labor to evaluate how models visually represent class, labor, and lower-income jobs.

Analyzing generated outputs for prompts mentioning 'a lifetime of domestic labor' to reveal implicit associations between specific types of work and elderly individuals, even in the absence of explicit age directives.
